opening.argument: The video is presented as a practical explanation of selling OneCoin through the XCoinx platform, not as a promise of rewards or an invitation to join an investment scheme. Its subject is plainly identified as “How can I SELL my OneCoin coins on the new XCoinx platform,” and the narration explains that it will show viewers “how sell or how to place the orders of coins inside the excoin platform.” The speaker further distinguishes purchase and sale settings, then demonstrates a market sale order. The visible interface supplies operational details such as quantity, price, expiration, transaction password, and order controls. Although this concerns financial activity, these instructions do not establish deceptive solicitation by the creator.
